subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: After explicit capability gating and live proof, should supported Copilot models switch to hosted search automatically, and should the shared wrapper become public Plugin SDK API?
rationale: The PR changes existing users' automatic search routing and establishes a third-party compatibility contract; source correctness alone cannot determine those product and API commitments.

options.title: Capability-gated internal implementation
options.body: Enable hosted search automatically only for explicitly capable Copilot models and keep the shared mutation helper provider-internal.

options.title: Capability-gated public API
options.body: Use explicit capability metadata and intentionally document the shared wrapper as supported Plugin SDK API.

options.title: Explicit user opt-in
options.body: Preserve managed search as the automatic default and require deliberate selection of Copilot-hosted search.

recommendation.title: Capability-gated internal implementation
recommendation.body: Enable hosted search automatically only for explicitly capable Copilot models and keep the shared mutation helper provider-internal.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the clearest merged-history trail across the Copilot wrapper and adjacent native-search implementation being generalized.
